_comment: Model presets for the web UI's Models panel at Mu2e (HEP_MODEL_PRESETS_FILE, set by setup.sh). The backends the aitools harness offers (goose-model.sh): vllm.fnal.gov is the .env's default endpoint, so it is not repeated here. 'guide' is shown step by step in the form. 'chatgpt': false hides the ChatGPT-subscription section (not an option at Fermilab).

presets.name: Fermilab LiteLLM
presets.note: litellm.fnal.gov: commercial and open models behind one Fermilab key.
guide: Open https://llm-keys.fnal.gov and log in with your Fermilab account (Services username and password, or Kerberos).
Create a key there and copy it: it is shown only once.
Paste it as the API key below, then click Fetch models: a list means the key works.
Pick a model and Save. Make it the active endpoint with the radio button, or pin single stages to it.

presets.name: ALCF inference
presets.note: Argonne's open models (sophia, metis, minerva, tara). No key: a Globus login.
guide: Click Log in with Globus below, open the link, and log in with your fnal.gov (or anl.gov) identity.
Copy the authorization code Globus shows and paste it into the login window.
Pick a cluster, then a model from its list, and Save.
ALCF asks for a fresh login every 30 days. If it refuses the login, log out at https://app.globus.org/logout and log in again.
